mintAuthority.summary: WPEN has six reviewed native issuer deployments on Ethereum, Base, Worldchain, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Native Mint Authority retains the shared issuer EOA's direct MINTER_ROLE and UUPS UPGRADER_ROLE, the Ripio Safe's DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and the Ethereum-only LimitedMinter; the separate LimitedMinterBridge and BridgeDeposit cross-chain rail is assessed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Ripio shared WPEN admin and MINTER_ROLE holder (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295015, hasRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE) and hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) both returned true. eth_getCode returned 0x (EOA). Same role confirmed via hasRole on Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain at same block range.

controls.label: Ripio WPEN multichain LimitedMinter contract
controls.evidence: At latest state, LimitedMinter 0xd168cfbbe260d48cd119497a9a2ee8482080c5e7 has non-empty code and WPEN.hasRole(MINTER_ROLE) returned true on Ethereum, BSC, Polygon, and Gnosis. Base and Worldchain returned no code and false role results.

review.evidence: Native mint-capable role holders were verified via hasRole() across Ethereum, Base, BSC, Polygon, Gnosis, and Worldchain. On 2026-08-16 the six native deployments resolved to implementation 0x9d6266a9167f17ff3dd20f63a474812d0cd47969; the issuer EOA 0x466c02e2...247b held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, MINTER_ROLE, and UPGRADER_ROLE on each deployment, the Ripio Safe held DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, and the Ethereum-only LimitedMinter remained a local issuer minter. The cross-chain LimitedMinterBridge and BridgeDeposit burn/mint rail is intentionally excluded from this native assessment and is recorded under Bridge Risk. The issuer EOA can mint and upgrade without an independent delay, while no wPEN-specific recurring whole-supply attestation or prudential authorization is evidenced. Wave 2 external review 2026-08-15 retained reconciliation as unknown after Ripio's wFIAT, local-stablecoin, security/PoR, and whitepaper materials yielded no wPEN-specific assets-and-liabilities report covering all six deployments. Codex wave 1 review 2026-08-15: the current Ripio wFIAT releases page lists wPEN as a product and records its first mint and dashboard updates, but no dated wPEN reserve certification or recurring liability-to-reserve reconciliation; no prudential supervisor is named.
